outcome: Depth, length and width of CSD
cohort: 189 women with CSD and 378 women without CSD with a history of caesarean section (CS) at the Obsterics and Gynaecology Hospital of Fudan University between January 2008 and February 2016
finding: Several factors were identified as risk factors for CSD, including CS time ≥85min, peripartum fever or infection, and retroflexed uterus; protective factors included age at last CS<30 years, intraoperative blood loss <150ml and double-layer closure.
